title: Empresa de China
text: The Empresa de China was a long-time projected conquest of China by the Spanish Empire. Proposed repeatedly through the 16th century as a natural culmination of the conquest of the Philippines, it involved the invasion and assimilation of the Ming dynasty by a coalition that would include Spaniards, Portuguese, Spanish subjects of Spanish Philippines, and Japanese allies from the Toyotomi regency, as well as potential masses of ethnic Chinese allies.
